```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")

# Upstream requirement:
#   01_data_import_cleaning.Rmd -> Chik_total
# Chik_total is already the confirmed chikungunya analytic population.

STUDY_START_YEAR <- 2016L
STUDY_END_YEAR   <- 2025L
STUDY_START_DATE <- as.Date("2016-01-01")
STUDY_END_DATE   <- as.Date("2025-12-31")
STUDY_LABEL      <- "2016-2025"

stopifnot(
  exists("Chik_total"),
  all(Chik_total$CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13)),
  all(as.Date(Chik_total$DT_SIN_PRI) >= STUDY_START_DATE),
  all(as.Date(Chik_total$DT_SIN_PRI) <= STUDY_END_DATE)
)

chik <- Chik_total %>%
  mutate(
    DT_SIN_PRI = as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI),
    year = lubridate::year(DT_SIN_PRI),
    code_muni = stringr::str_pad(substr(as.character(ID_MUNICIP), 1, 6), 6, pad = "0"),
    code_state = substr(code_muni, 1, 2)
  )
```

> **Revision note (Reviewer 1 / Plan Step 19).** The wavelet analysis is
> retained only as a supplementary descriptive analysis. A ten-year series,
> including the COVID-era surveillance disruption, is too short to support
> strong inference about multi-year periodicity, and an annual cycle in an
> Aedes-borne infection in Brazil is not itself a principal finding. The main
> analysis in this file is therefore the macro-region peak/phase-timing
> analysis below, which directly addresses whether the geography and seasonal
> timing of epidemic activity changed across the study period.

## Supplement: national monthly time series

```{r monthly-series}
monthly_cases_obs <- chik %>%
  mutate(
    month_date = lubridate::floor_date(DT_SIN_PRI, unit = "month")
  ) %>%
  count(month_date, name = "cases")

all_months <- tibble(
  month_date = seq(STUDY_START_DATE, STUDY_END_DATE, by = "month")
)

monthly_cases <- all_months %>%
  left_join(monthly_cases_obs, by = "month_date") %>%
  mutate(
    cases = tidyr::replace_na(cases, 0L),
    year = lubridate::year(month_date),
    month = lubridate::month(month_date)
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(monthly_cases) == 12L * length(STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR),
  min(monthly_cases$month_date) == STUDY_START_DATE,
  max(monthly_cases$month_date) == as.Date("2025-12-01")
)
```

## Supplement: wavelet transform

```{r wavelet-transform}
wavelet_data <- data.frame(
  date = format(monthly_cases$month_date, "%Y-%m-%d"),
  cases = monthly_cases$cases
)

wt <- WaveletComp::analyze.wavelet(
  wavelet_data,
  my.series = "cases",
  loess.span = 0,
  dt = 1/12,
  dj = 1/20,
  lowerPeriod = 2/12,
  upperPeriod = 5,
  make.pval = TRUE,
  n.sim = 200,
  date.format = "%Y-%m-%d"
)
```

## Supplement: scalogram

```{r scalogram}
WaveletComp::wt.image(
  wt,
  color.key = "interval",
  n.levels = 250,
  legend.params = list(lab = "Wavelet power"),
  show.date = TRUE,
  date.format = "%Y-%m-%d",
  periodlab = "Period (years)",
  timelab = "Year",
  siglvl = 0.01,
  spec.time.axis = list(
    at = format(
      seq(as.Date("2016-01-01"), as.Date("2025-01-01"), by = "year"),
      "%Y-%m-%d"
    ),
    labels = as.character(STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR)
  )
)
```

## Supplement: global wavelet power spectrum

```{r global-power-spectrum}
gws <- data.frame(
  period = wt$Period,
  power = wt$Power.avg,
  pval = wt$Power.avg.pval
) %>%
  mutate(sig = pval < 0.01)

period_breaks <- c(2/12, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5)
period_labels <- c("2 mo", "6 mo", "1 yr", "2 yr", "3 yr", "5 yr")

p_wavelet_global <- ggplot(gws, aes(x = period)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = subset(gws, sig),
    aes(ymin = 0, ymax = power, fill = "p < 0.01 vs AR(1) red noise"),
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(y = power, color = "Global wavelet power"), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 1.05, y = max(gws$power, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.97,
    label = "1 year", hjust = 0, size = 3.2, color = "grey25"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = period_breaks,
    labels = period_labels,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("p < 0.01 vs AR(1) red noise" = "#B2182B"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Global wavelet power" = "black"), name = NULL) +
  labs(
    x = "Period",
    y = "Average wavelet power",
    title = "Global wavelet power spectrum"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_wavelet_global

dominant_period <- wt$Period[which.max(wt$Power.avg)]
sig_periods <- wt$Period[wt$Power.avg.pval < 0.01]

cat("Dominant global-wavelet period:", round(dominant_period, 3), "years\n")
if (length(sig_periods) > 0) {
  cat(
    "Range of periods with global-wavelet p < 0.01:",
    round(min(sig_periods), 3), "to", round(max(sig_periods), 3), "years\n"
  )
} else {
  cat("No global-wavelet periods had p < 0.01.\n")
}
```

The significant-period range above is a descriptive range of periods whose
simulation-based p-values are below 0.01; it is **not** a confidence interval.
No inference about stable multi-year periodicity should be made from this
short, surveillance-disrupted series.

## Main analysis: weekly epidemic timing by macro-region

```{r region-weekly-series}

# ============================================================
# Regional weekly series for seasonal phase / peak timing
# Calendar year is defined from the notification date itself,
# so cases in 1-3 Jan 2016 are not assigned to a 2015 week.
# ISO week 53 is folded into week 52 for a common 52-week
# circular scale across years.
# ============================================================

chik_region <- chik %>%
  left_join(state_region_lookup, by = "code_state")

stopifnot(sum(is.na(chik_region$region)) == 0)

region_weekly_obs <- chik_region %>%
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(DT_SIN_PRI),
    week_of_year = pmin(lubridate::isoweek(DT_SIN_PRI), 52L)
  ) %>%
  count(region, year, week_of_year, name = "cases")

region_weekly <- tidyr::crossing(
  region = unique(state_region_lookup$region),
  year = STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR,
  week_of_year = 1:52
) %>%
  left_join(
    region_weekly_obs,
    by = c("region", "year", "week_of_year")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cases = tidyr::replace_na(cases, 0L)
  )

cat("Completed region-week rows:", nrow(region_weekly), "\n")

stopifnot(
  nrow(region_weekly) == 5L * 10L * 52L,
  sum(region_weekly$cases) == nrow(chik)
)




```

## Peak week and circular seasonal phase

A single maximum week is intuitive but can be unstable when two adjacent weeks
have similar counts. We therefore report both (i) the observed peak week and
(ii) a case-weighted circular mean week, which summarizes the center of the
seasonal epidemic curve while respecting the wrap-around between weeks 52 and
1. The resultant length (`phase_concentration`, 0 to 1) describes how tightly
cases are concentrated around that seasonal phase.

```{r timing-estimates}
calc_timing <- function(df) {
  total_cases <- sum(df$cases, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (total_cases == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      annual_cases = 0L,
      peak_week = NA_integer_,
      peak_week_cases = 0L,
      phase_week = NA_real_,
      phase_concentration = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  # Observed peak week. Earliest week is selected if an exact tie occurs.
  peak_row <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(cases), week_of_year) %>%
    slice(1)

  theta <- 2 * pi * (df$week_of_year - 1) / 52
  w <- df$cases
  C <- sum(w * cos(theta), na.rm = TRUE) / total_cases
  S <- sum(w * sin(theta), na.rm = TRUE) / total_cases
  mean_angle <- atan2(S, C)
  if (mean_angle < 0) mean_angle <- mean_angle + 2 * pi

  phase_week <- 1 + 52 * mean_angle / (2 * pi)
  resultant <- sqrt(C^2 + S^2)

  tibble(
    annual_cases = as.integer(total_cases),
    peak_week = as.integer(peak_row$week_of_year),
    peak_week_cases = as.integer(peak_row$cases),
    phase_week = phase_week,
    phase_concentration = resultant
  )
}

region_year_timing <- region_weekly %>%
  group_by(region, year) %>%
  group_modify(~ calc_timing(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()

print(region_year_timing %>% arrange(region, year), n = Inf)
```

## Main figure: epidemic timing over time

```{r peak-phase-figure}
p_peak_timing <- ggplot(
  region_year_timing,
  aes(x = year, y = peak_week, group = region)
) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = region), linewidth = 0.65, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = region, size = annual_cases), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(
    aes(y = phase_week),
    shape = 1,
    size = 2.8,
    stroke = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 52), breaks = c(1, 13, 26, 39, 52)) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Annual confirmed cases", range = c(1.5, 7)) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Seasonal timing of confirmed chikungunya activity by macro-region, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    subtitle = "Filled points: peak week; open circles: case-weighted circular mean week",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Week of year",
    linetype = "Macro-region",
    shape = "Macro-region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_peak_timing
```

## Focused comparison of the two epidemic fronts

```{r focal-wave-comparison}
focal_timing <- region_year_timing %>%
  filter(
    (region == "Northeast" & year %in% 2016:2017) |
      (region == "Center-West" & year %in% 2024:2025)
  ) %>%
  arrange(region, year)

print(focal_timing)

focal_summary <- focal_timing %>%
  mutate(
    epidemic_front = case_when(
      region == "Northeast" ~ "Northeast, 2016-2017",
      region == "Center-West" ~ "Center-West, 2024-2025",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(epidemic_front) %>%
  summarise(
    years = n(),
    median_peak_week = median(peak_week, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_phase_week = mean(phase_week, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_phase_concentration = mean(phase_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_confirmed_cases = sum(annual_cases),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(focal_summary)
```

This comparison is descriptive. With only two focal years per epidemic front,
we do not use a formal between-period hypothesis test; the purpose is to show
whether the geographic relocation of epidemic burden was accompanied by a
material shift in seasonal timing.

## Scope sanity checks

```{r scope-sanity}
cat("Study period:", STUDY_LABEL, "\n")
cat("Confirmed chikungunya cases:", nrow(chik), "\n")
cat("National monthly observations:", nrow(monthly_cases), "\n")
cat("Macro-regions represented:", n_distinct(chik_region$region), "\n")
cat("Region-year timing rows:", nrow(region_year_timing), "\n")

stopifnot(
  nrow(monthly_cases) == 120L,
  n_distinct(chik_region$region) == 5L,
  nrow(region_year_timing) == 5L * 10L,
  all(region_year_timing$year %in% STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR),
  sum(region_year_timing$annual_cases) == nrow(chik)
)
```
